WITH matched_signals AS (
  SELECT s.pulsepersec, t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
),
telescope_avg AS (
  SELECT telescregistry, equipstatus, AVG(pulsepersec) as telescope_avg
  FROM matched_signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescregistry, equipstatus
),
status_avg AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, AVG(telescope_avg) as status_average
  FROM telescope_avg
  GROUP BY equipstatus
),
first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_average) as mean1 FROM status_avg
),
above_first AS (
  SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.status_average, (sa.status_average - fm.mean1) as excess1
  FROM status_avg sa
  CROSS JOIN first_mean fm
  WHERE sa.status_average > fm.mean1
),
second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_average) as mean2 FROM above_first
),
above_second AS (
  SELECT af.equipstatus, af.status_average, af.excess1, (af.status_average - sm.mean2) as excess2
  FROM above_first af
  CROSS JOIN second_mean sm
  WHERE af.status_average > sm.mean2
)
SELECT 
  AVG(status_average) as final_pulse_avg,
  AVG(excess1) as avg_excess_over_mean1,
  AVG(excess2) as avg_excess_over_mean2
FROM above_second
